(1) 由高斯定理，球面外电势 $U = \frac{\sigma R^2}{\varepsilon_0 r}$，球面内电势 $U = \frac{\sigma R}{\varepsilon_0}$。将电荷 $q$ 从球心移到无穷远，电场力做功 $W = qU_A = \frac{q\sigma R}{\varepsilon_0}$。

(2) 由高斯定理 $\oint \vec{E}\cdot\mathrm{d}\vec{S}=0$ 得 $E_r = -\frac{r}{2}\frac{\mathrm{d}E_x}{\mathrm{d}x}$。粒子受力 $F_r = -qE_r = \frac{qr}{2}\frac{\mathrm{d}E_x}{\mathrm{d}x}$，冲量 $I_r = \int F_r \mathrm{d}t \approx \frac{qr}{2v_0}\int \mathrm{d}E_x = \frac{qE_x r}{2v_0}$，横向速度 $v_r = \frac{qE_x r}{2mv_0}$，偏转角 $\theta \approx \frac{v_r}{v_0} = \frac{qE_x r}{2mv_0^2}$。
